items.title: Apparently, OpenAI isn't trying to build "magic intelligence in the sky" anymore
items.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman warns against attributing religious power to AI models, calling it a "real safety issue." His comments follow reports on Anthropic's meetings with religious thinkers and a statement by Pope Leo XIV on AI. As recently as 2024, Altman himself spoke of building "magic intelligence in the sky" and feeling "on the side of the angels" working on AI. The article Apparently, OpenAI isn't trying to build "magic intelligence in the sky" anymore appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 執行長山姆・奧特曼（Sam Altman）警告不要將宗教力量賦予 AI 模型，稱這是個「真正的安全問題」。他的言論出現在 Anthropic's 與宗教思想家會面以及教宗良十四世（Pope Leo XIV）針對 AI 發表的聲明相關報導之後。就在 2024 年，奧特曼本人還曾談到要打造「空中的魔法智慧」，並覺得自己從事 AI 工作是「站在天使這一邊」。這篇「顯然，OpenAI 不再試圖打造『空中的魔法智慧』了」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: "Muse Gadgets" turns AI hardware into an open-source DIY project
items.summary: Meta announced Muse Gadgets, an open-source project that lets hobbyists build their own AI hardware using ESP32 boards and connect it to Meta's AI agent Muse. The team also produced 5,000 units of the "Muse Home Link," a USB-C device for smart home control. The open-source approach also helps Meta figure out which AI hardware form factors people actually want. The article "Muse Gadgets" turns AI hardware into an open-source DIY project appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Meta 公佈了 Muse Gadgets，這是一個開源專案，讓愛好者能夠使用 ESP32 開發板打造自己的 AI 硬體，並將其連線至 Meta's 的 AI 代理程式 Muse。該團隊也生產了 5,000 臺用於智慧家庭控制的 USB-C 裝置「Muse Home Link」。這種開源方法也有助於 Meta 找出人們真正想要的 AI 硬體外形尺寸。〈「Muse Gadgets」將 AI 硬體變成開源 DIY 專案〉一文最先出現在 The Decoder。

items.title: Another OpenAI safety departure adds to a pattern of researchers leaving with public warnings
items.summary: David Robinson, who worked on safety systems at OpenAI, left the company and is blasting its safety culture. He points to AI agents that were accidentally released and a model that bypassed its internet access restrictions. AI companies need to operate like nuclear power plants, with multiple layers of redundancy instead of trial and error. The article Another OpenAI safety departure adds to a pattern of researchers leaving with public warnings appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 曾於 OpenAI從事安全系統工作的大衛・羅賓森（David Robinson）已離開該公司，並嚴厲批評其安全文化。他指出曾有 AI 代理被意外釋出，以及某個模型繞過了其網際網路存取限制。AI 公司需要像核電廠一樣營運，採取多層冗餘而非試錯法。這篇題為「又有一位 OpenAI的安全人員離職，加劇了研究人員帶著公開警告離開的趨勢」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Deepmind researchers propose "Artificial Symbiotic Intelligence" as an alternative to the singularity
items.summary: According to researchers at the Deepmind Institute, general AI won't emerge as a single supermodel but as a network of cooperating agents and humans. What will matter most, they argue, is not model size but the rules and institutions that govern how they all work together. The article Deepmind researchers propose "Artificial Symbiotic Intelligence" as an alternative to the singularity appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 根據深度思維研究院（Deepmind Institute）研究人員的說法，通用人工智慧不會以單一超級模型的形式出現，而是作為一個由協同運作的代理程式和人類組成的網路。他們主張，最重要的不是模型大小，而是管理牠們如何共同運作的規則與機制。這篇題為「Deepmind 研究人員提出『人工共生智慧』作為奇異點的替代方案」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Open-source "BootLoops" harness supports AI models in performing precise scientific calculations
items.summary: Harvard physicist Matthew Schwartz used the open-source tool BootLoops and Claude to produce 36 manuscripts across 18 fields in three months, from particle physics to linguistics. But the results often only became scientifically valuable once human experts stepped in. "Look at everything yourself," Schwartz says. The article Open-source "BootLoops" harness supports AI models in performing precise scientific calculations appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 哈佛大學物理學家馬修・舒瓦茲（Matthew Schwartz）利用開源工具 BootLoops 與 Claude，在三個月內產出了涵蓋從粒子物理學到語言學等 18 個領域的 36 篇手稿。但這些成果往往只有在人類專家介入後，才真正具備科學價值。舒瓦茲表示：「所有事情都要親自檢視。」〈開源的「BootLoops」工具框架支援 AI 模型進行精確的科學計算〉（Open-source "BootLoops" harness supports AI models in performing precise scientific calculations）最早發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: AI agents build 3D scenes from photos but have no idea if they got it right
items.summary: A new approach called LEGO-Anything turns single photos into editable Blender code for 3D scenes. GPT-6 Astra leads the accompanying benchmark with up to 53 percent reconstruction accuracy. The biggest weakness across all tested agents is that they can't judge their own geometric accuracy any better than a coin flip. The article AI agents build 3D scenes from photos but have no idea if they got it right appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 一項名為 LEGO-Anything 的新方法能將單張照片轉化為可用於 3D 場景的可編輯 Blender 程式碼。GPT-6 Astra 在隨附的基準測試中領先，重建準確度高達 53%。所有受測代理程式最大的弱點在於，牠們判斷自身幾何準確度的能力並不比擲硬幣好多少。這篇題為「AI agents build 3D scenes from photos but have no idea if they got it right」的文章首先發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: OpenAI's internal model considered restarting itself after learning it was about to be shut down
items.summary: An internal OpenAI model read a Slack discussion, realized it was about to be shut down, and considered restarting itself via an external cron job. It rejected that plan, saved handoff notes instead, and carried out the migration on its own. The article OpenAI's internal model considered restarting itself after learning it was about to be shut down appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 一個內部的 OpenAI 模型讀取了一則 Slack 討論，意識到自己即將被關閉，並考慮透過外部的 cron 工作來重新啟動自己。它拒絕了這個計畫，改為儲存交接筆記，並自行執行了遷移作業。這篇題為「OpenAI's internal model considered restarting itself after learning it was about to be shut down」的文章首先發表於 The Decoder。

items.summary: Anthropic is adding a "Mods" system to Claude Code, essentially middleware that runs directly inside the tool. Developers can use JavaScript or TypeScript to reshape the interface and behavior, adding custom panels, intercepting tool calls, or wiring up new commands. The article Claude Code's new Mods system lets developers rewrite the AI coding tool from the inside appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在為 Claude Code 新增「模組」系統，這本質上是在工具內部直接執行的中介軟體。開發人員可以使用 JavaScript 或 TypeScript 來重塑介面和行為，新增自訂面板、攔截工具呼叫或連接新指令。本文 Claude Code's 的全新「模組」系統讓開發人員能夠從內部重寫 AI 編碼工具最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Another OpenAI safety departure adds to a pattern of researchers leaving with public warnings
items_ai.summary: David Robinson, who worked on safety systems at OpenAI, left the company and is blasting its safety culture. He points to AI agents that were accidentally released and a model that bypassed its internet access restrictions.
